data: name as entered in the form;
booking details (check-in and check-out dates, number of guests);

ensuring the website operates correctly and securely.
consent.actions: Consent is given for the following operations: collection, recording, systematisation, accumulation, storage, updating (refreshing, modification), retrieval, use, transfer (provision, access) to third parties for the stated purposes, blocking, deletion and destruction. consent.thirdPartiesIntro: The operator may engage the following parties to process the data, or transfer it to them, for the stated purposes:

the website hosting provider - hosting the website and storing data on servers located in the Russian Federation;
the email (SMTP) provider - delivering request notifications to the operator;
state authorities - in the cases, to the extent and in the manner established by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
consent.term: Consent is valid from the moment it is given until the purposes of processing are achieved or until it is withdrawn. items.author: Alexey G.
items.text: A wonderful quiet spot by the sea. Crystal clear water, an oyster farm right on the beach. The owners are very hospitable, everything for a comfortable stay.

items.author: Anastasia B.
items.text: Beautiful view of Cape Meganom from the second-floor balcony. The houses are cozy, smell of wood. Well-kept grounds with a pool and playground.

items.author: Dmitry L.
items.text: The owners Ekaterina and Andrey are incredibly welcoming people. The houses are clean with everything you need. The wood-fired banya is amazing!

items.author: Mikhail M.
items.text: Peace, nature, crystal clear sea. They organized a fishing trip - we caught horse mackerel! Shuttle to the beach three times a day, very convenient.

items.author: Olga K.
items.text: Perfect place for a family vacation. Kids loved the pool and fish ponds. Quiet, peaceful, close to nature.

items.author: Sergey V.
items.text: Beautiful place, fresh air with pine scent. Great BBQ area - tandoor and grill. There's a dirt road to the beach, better to drive.

sections.title: General Provisions
sections.content:
This Personal Data Processing Policy (the "Policy") defines how personal data of users of the meganom-eco.ru website is processed and protected. It has been prepared in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27 July 2006 "On Personal Data".

The Policy is published pursuant to part 2 of article 18.1 of that law and provides unrestricted access to information about how personal data is processed and about the data protection requirements in place.

The Policy is informational and does not in itself constitute consent to the processing of personal data. Consent is given separately, freely and in the data subject’s own interest, by ticking the corresponding box in a form on the website.

sections.title: Operator Details
sections.content: The personal data operator is the entity whose details are set out below. All matters relating to the processing of personal data, including withdrawal of consent and exercise of data subject rights, should be addressed to the contacts listed.

sections.title: Legal Grounds for Processing
sections.content: Personal data is processed on the following legal grounds:
items: Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27 July 2006 "On Personal Data"
consent of the data subject given through the website forms (clause 1, part 1, article 6 of 152-FZ)
performance of the hotel services contract to which the data subject is a party (clause 5, part 1, article 6 of 152-FZ)
regulations governing the provision of hotel services and the registration of guests at accommodation facilities
Federal Law No. 38-FZ of 13 March 2006 "On Advertising", as regards sending informational and promotional messages subject to the recipient’s prior consent

sections.title: Categories of Data Subjects
items: website visitors who take no targeted action - only technical data and cookie data is processed
users who submit an enquiry through the contact form
users who register an account on the website
guests who submit a booking request and the persons they name as occupants
newsletter subscribers

sections.title: Categories of Personal Data Processed
sections.content: The Operator does not process special categories of personal data (racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, health, sex life) or biometric personal data.
items: full name or the name provided by the user in a form
email address
contact phone number
booking details: selected accommodation, check-in and check-out dates, number of guests, accommodation preferences
the content of a free-form enquiry submitted by the user
account data: email address, an irreversible password hash, and a profile image if uploaded by the user
technical data: IP address, browser type and version (User-Agent), date and time of access to the website
website usage data collected by cookies and Yandex.Metrica: referral source, pages viewed, device type, region, on-site actions

sections.title: Purposes of Processing
items: receiving and handling booking requests, concluding and performing the hotel services contract
contacting the user to confirm a booking and to respond to an enquiry
creating and maintaining the user account on the website
processing payments and refunds
sending informational and promotional messages where separate consent has been given
collecting anonymised traffic statistics and improving service quality and website performance
ensuring the website operates correctly and securely, and protecting it from automated requests
complying with the obligations imposed on the Operator by the legislation of the Russian Federation

sections.title: Procedure and Conditions of Processing
sections.content:
Personal data is processed both with and without the use of automation, and includes collection, recording, systematisation, accumulation, storage, updating, retrieval, use, transfer, blocking, deletion and destruction.

Recording, systematisation, accumulation, storage, updating and retrieval of personal data of citizens of the Russian Federation is carried out using databases located in the territory of the Russian Federation (part 5, article 18 of 152-FZ).

The Operator does not take decisions producing legal effects concerning the data subject, or otherwise affecting their rights and legitimate interests, based solely on automated processing of personal data (article 16 of 152-FZ).

sections.title: Processing and Retention Periods
sections.content: Processing ceases once the purposes of processing are achieved, upon withdrawal of consent by the data subject, or upon detection of unlawful processing, unless a different retention period is established by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
items: data submitted when booking - for the term of the contract and the following three years (the general limitation period)
account data - until the account is deleted or consent is withdrawn
data from enquiries submitted through the contact form - one year from receipt of the enquiry
a newsletter subscriber’s email address - until they unsubscribe
cookie data and Yandex.Metrica statistics - for the periods set by the terms of use of the relevant service

sections.title: Destruction of Personal Data
sections.content:
Once the purposes of processing are achieved, upon withdrawal of consent by the data subject, or upon detection of unlawful processing, the Operator ceases processing and destroys the personal data within a period not exceeding 30 days from the date of the relevant event, unless otherwise provided by the legislation of the Russian Federation.

Destruction is carried out in a manner that precludes further processing and recovery of the data: by deleting the corresponding records from databases and backups, and by destroying physical media in a way that prevents their contents from being recovered. Destruction is recorded in a formal act.

sections.title: Transfer to Third Parties and Cross-Border Transfer
sections.content:
The Operator does not sell personal data and does not disclose it to third parties, except in the cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation and for transfers to the parties engaged to achieve the purposes set out above.

The Operator does not carry out cross-border transfers of personal data.
items: Yandex LLC - website traffic analytics (Yandex.Metrica), servers located in the Russian Federation
the website hosting provider - hosting the website and storing data on servers located in the Russian Federation
the email service provider - delivering notifications of requests and enquiries
state authorities - in the cases, to the extent and in the manner established by the legislation of the Russian Federation

sections.title: Use of Cookies
sections.content: The website uses cookies to ensure correct operation and analytics. Analytical cookies (Yandex.Metrica) are enabled only after you give consent; you can change or withdraw your choice at any time via "Cookie settings" at the bottom of the site. Necessary cookies are always active and required for the site to work.
items: Necessary - ensure basic website functionality and security
Analytical (Yandex.Metrica) - help understand how users interact with the website; enabled only with consent

sections.title: Personal Data Security Measures
sections.content: The Operator applies the legal, organisational and technical measures provided for by articles 18.1 and 19 of 152-FZ to protect personal data against unlawful or accidental access, destruction, alteration, blocking, copying, provision and dissemination.
items: publishing this Policy and providing unrestricted access to it
limiting the number of people authorised to process personal data and briefing them on statutory requirements
transmitting data between the user’s browser and the website over the secure HTTPS protocol
storing account passwords solely as irreversible cryptographic hashes
restricting access to the website administration area
internal monitoring of processing for compliance with statutory requirements

sections.title: Rights of Data Subjects
sections.content: To exercise the rights listed above, or to withdraw consent, send a request to the Operator’s email address given in the "Operator Details" section. A response is provided within a period not exceeding 30 days from receipt of the request.
items: obtain information concerning the processing of their personal data
require that personal data be corrected, blocked or destroyed if it is incomplete, outdated, inaccurate or unlawfully obtained
withdraw consent to the processing of personal data at any time
opt out of the informational newsletter
appeal against the Operator’s acts or omissions to Roskomnadzor or in court

sections.title: Changes to the Policy
sections.content: The Operator may amend this Policy. The current version, together with the date it was adopted, is permanently available on this page. Material changes are communicated to users by publication on the website.

sections.title: General Provisions
sections.content:
These Terms of Use govern the relationship between Meganom Eco-house (hereinafter - the Administration) and the website user (hereinafter - the User).

Use of the website constitutes the User's unconditional acceptance of these Terms. If the User disagrees, they must stop using the website.

sections.title: Subject of the Agreement
sections.content: The Administration provides the User with access to information about hotel services, the ability to book rooms online, and other services available on the website.

sections.title: User Rights and Obligations
sections.content: The User agrees to provide accurate data when booking and not to use the website for unlawful purposes.
items: Access information about rooms and services
Book rooms through the website
Leave reviews about services received
Contact customer support
Not use the website for unlawful purposes
Not take actions that disrupt the normal operation of the website

sections.title: Administration Rights and Obligations
items: Modify website content without prior notice
Restrict access in case of violation of the Terms
Ensure website operability
Process personal data in accordance with the Privacy Policy
Review User requests within a reasonable time

sections.title: Booking and Payment
sections.content:
A booking is considered confirmed once the User receives a notification to the specified email address. The cost of accommodation is determined by the current rates published on the website.

Cancellation and refund conditions are governed by the rules in effect at the time the booking is made.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.content: All website materials (texts, photographs, design, logos) are intellectual property of the Administration and are protected by applicable law. Use of materials without the Administration's written consent is prohibited.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.content: The Administration is not liable for temporary unavailability of the website due to technical reasons and does not guarantee uninterrupted operation of the website.

sections.title: Dispute Resolution
sections.content: All disputes and disagreements shall be resolved through negotiations. If no agreement can be reached, the dispute shall be referred to a court at the Administration's location in accordance with applicable law.

veter-peremen-myata.title: «Wind of Change» - 3-room eco-house (Mint territory)
veter-peremen-myata.description: Individual 3-room eco-house with terrace and kitchen on the Mint territory
veter-peremen-myata.fullDescription: A standalone three-room eco-house «Wind of Change» on the Mint eco-territory - your private retreat at the foot of Cape Meganom. A spacious open terrace with garden furniture, a fully equipped kitchen and a BBQ area create perfect conditions for a secluded family holiday. The complex is 700 metres from the TAVRIDA.ART cultural centre and 8 kilometres from central Sudak. Accommodates up to 6 guests.

veter-peremen-med.title: «Wind of Change» - 3-room eco-house (Honey territory)
veter-peremen-med.description: Individual 3-room eco-house with terrace and kitchen on the Honey territory
veter-peremen-med.fullDescription: A three-room eco-house «Wind of Change» on the Honey eco-territory - ideal for family or group holidays surrounded by Crimean nature. A private terrace, fully equipped kitchen, vineyard and BBQ area provide comfort and privacy. The complex is located at the foot of Cape Meganom, 700 metres from TAVRIDA.ART and 8 km from Sudak.

shale.title: «Chalet» - 2-room eco-house with terrace
shale.description: Individual 2-room eco-house with terrace and shared kitchen
shale.fullDescription: The two-room eco-house «Chalet» is a cosy standalone cottage with its own terrace on the Honey eco-territory. Warm wooden interiors, a well-kept garden and quiet surroundings offer a truly relaxing retreat away from city noise. The shared kitchen, parking and pool are available to all guests. Accommodates up to 4 guests.

kvartet-grand.title: «Quartet Grand» - eco-room with balcony
kvartet-grand.description: Standard eco-room with balcony and shared kitchen
kvartet-grand.fullDescription: A cosy standard eco-room «Quartet Grand» with a balcony overlooking the grounds. Well-equipped with air conditioning and everything needed for a comfortable stay. The shared kitchen on-site lets you cook your own meals. A great choice for couples and solo travellers who value good quality at a reasonable price.

standart-kuhnya.title: Standard room with shared kitchen
standart-kuhnya.description: Standard twin room with shared kitchen access, sleeps up to 3
standart-kuhnya.fullDescription: A comfortable twin room in the main building with shared kitchen access - a simple, functional option for guests who spend most of their time outdoors or at the sea. Air conditioning, Wi-Fi and fresh linen are provided. The pool, garden and vineyard are just steps away. Sleeps up to 3 guests.

standart-balkon.title: Standard room with balcony
standart-balkon.description: Standard twin room with balcony and shared kitchen, sleeps up to 4
standart-balkon.fullDescription:
The standard room with a balcony is in the main building. At 22 m² it sleeps up to 4 guests, more than any other standard room, which makes it a popular choice for groups of friends and families with children who do not need a separate cottage.

Its key feature is a private balcony overlooking the grounds: a good spot for coffee before heading to the beach or for unwinding in the evening once the heat eases. The room has air conditioning, a fridge and Wi-Fi; bed linen and towels are included.

There is no kitchen in the room itself, but it opens onto the fully equipped shared kitchen, so breakfast and dinner are easy to cook yourself. The BBQ zone with a tandoor and grill is close by.

The outdoor pool is open from May to October, and the grounds include a playground, garden and vineyard. A free shuttle runs to Meganom and Oyster beaches at 8:00, 12:00 and 17:00, and you can leave your car in the free parking with CCTV.

semeynyy-balkon.title: Family 2-room suite with balcony
semeynyy-balkon.description: Two-room family suite with balcony and kitchen, sleeps up to 4
semeynyy-balkon.fullDescription:
The family room with a balcony offers two separate rooms with a total area of 32 m² in the main building. It sleeps 4: parents and children can stay in different rooms, and two couples travelling together do not have to share one room.

Unlike the other family room, this one has a balcony overlooking the garden. Once the children are asleep, it is a calm place to sit outside: quiet hours on the grounds run from 23:00 to 07:00. The room has air conditioning, a fridge and Wi-Fi, and a baby cot is available on request at no extra charge.

Meals are easy to prepare in the shared kitchen, and on summer evenings the whole family can gather around the grill. Children will find plenty to do: a playground, fish ponds and a pool open from May to October.

A free shuttle takes guests to the sea three times a day. Sudak is 8 km away, a wood-fired pizzeria is a 5-minute walk, and grocery shops are in neighbouring Bogatovka, 2 km away.

semeynyy-topcan.title: Family 2-room suite with bed
semeynyy-topcan.description: Two-room family suite with bed and kitchen, sleeps up to 5
semeynyy-topcan.fullDescription: A large two-room family suite featuring a spacious bed for relaxation. Designed to sleep up to 5 guests - an ideal solution for families with children. Two separate rooms provide the privacy you need, and the shared kitchen lets you cook for the whole family. The pool, garden and vineyard are at your disposal.

items.q: How do I book a room?
items.a: Choose a room and dates on the booking page, fill in your contact details and submit the request. Our manager will contact you within 2 hours to confirm. You can also reach us via the contact form.
A deposit of 30% of the total stay is required after booking confirmation. The remaining amount is paid upon arrival by cash or card.

Cancellations more than 7 days before check-in are free of charge and the deposit is fully refunded. Cancellations within 7 days are non-refundable. Cancellations within 48 hours incur a charge of the first night's rate.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept cash and bank cards (Mir, Visa, Mastercard) upon arrival. The deposit can be paid by bank transfer - we'll send the details after booking confirmation.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Standard check-in is from 14:00, check-out by 12:00. Early check-in or late check-out can be arranged in advance subject to availability - please let us know when booking.
Yes, there is a secure, monitored car park with CCTV on the grounds. Parking is free for all guests.

items.q: Is airport or station transfer available?
items.a: We offer free shuttle transfers to the Meganom beaches on a daily schedule. Transfers from Simferopol Airport or Feodosia railway station can be arranged for an additional fee - enquire when booking.
The minimum stay is 2 nights. During peak season (July–August) the minimum stay is 3 nights.

items.q: Do the cabins have a kitchen?
items.a: Comfort, Suite and Deluxe cabins have a kitchenette with fridge, electric hob, kettle and cookware. Standard cabins have a fridge. All guests have access to the shared BBQ kitchen area on the grounds.
Yes, free high-speed Wi-Fi is available in all cabins and throughout the grounds - fast enough for remote work and video calls.
All cabins have air conditioning. This is especially important during the hot Crimean summer.

items.q: Is there a sauna or banya?
items.a: Yes! Our traditional Russian wood-fired banya is one of the highlights of the complex. It's available by reservation; birch and oak whisks are provided. Ask for pricing when booking.
There is an outdoor pool open during the summer season from May to October. Access is free for all guests.

items.q: How far is it to the sea?
items.a: The complex is about 5–7 minutes by car from the beach at Cape Meganom. Our free shuttle to the beach runs several times a day.

items.q: How do I get here from Simferopol?
items.a: By car: 1 hour 40 minutes via Belogorsk to Sudak, then 10 minutes to Mindalnoye village. By bus: take the Simferopol–Sudak route, then a taxi (10–15 min). We'll send the exact address and GPS coordinates after booking confirmation.

items.q: Are there shops and cafes nearby?
items.a: Bogatovka village, 2 km away, has grocery shops. Sudak (15 minutes by car) offers full city amenities: markets, restaurants, pharmacies and ATMs.

Absolutely! We welcome families with children of all ages. A baby cot is available on request at no extra charge. There's a play area on the grounds, and our shuttle runs to family-friendly beaches in Sudak.
Yes, we welcome guests with pets up to 10 kg. Please let us know when booking. A refundable cleaning deposit of 500 roubles applies.
Smoking is permitted only in designated outdoor areas. Smoking inside cabins and enclosed spaces is strictly prohibited.

The main season runs from April to October. From November to March some cabins operate in 'quiet season' mode - banya, nature and peaceful relaxation away from the summer crowds. Please check availability when booking off-season.
